description: A vulnerability in BIG-IP systems occurs when an HTTP profile and an iRule using the PSC::ip_address command are configured on a virtual server. This flaw can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate unexpectedly, disrupting traffic and potentially allowing remote code execution (RCE). The issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
